title: Read research costs and qualified completion estimates
description: A developer inspects the shipped CampaignResearch component with reducer-derived research and science ledger specimens. Keyboard disclosure changes no campaign state. Component observations are not live service acknowledgements, scheduling or authorization acceptance.

steps.description: Read the developer gallery scope before inspecting research.
steps.acknowledgement: The gallery explicitly says samples do not submit game commands.
verifications: All five production research specimens are available by name.
The full research forecast is contained after deliberate gallery scrolling, without horizontal document overflow.

steps.description: Open the pending forecast with Enter and read the cost, exact effect and rate qualification.
steps.acknowledgement: The native disclosure opens and retains keyboard focus; this is a local presentation outcome.
verifications: Investing costs 20 science, has the recorded 1.01 exponent, distinguishes construction dividends and explains the actual state.
The full research forecast is contained after deliberate gallery scrolling, without horizontal document overflow.

steps.description: Use End in the bounded forecast to read the rate qualification and active target without changing research.
steps.acknowledgement: Keyboard focus stays in the forecast, which reaches its final active-target explanation.
verifications: The final active-target paragraph is fully contained, with unchanged selected investing and genuine applied order status.
The full research forecast is contained after deliberate gallery scrolling, without horizontal document overflow.

steps.description: Close the disclosure with Space, keeping focus and the selected research choice.
steps.acknowledgement: The disclosure closes without queuing research.
verifications: The investing radio remains selected.
The full research forecast is contained after deliberate gallery scrolling, without horizontal document overflow.
